quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo on the momentum of the Knicks' winning streak
quotes.excerpt: In basketball there is a momentum. If you win 11 in a row, then you can keep going.

text_blocks.speaker: Marlon
text_blocks.text: I think Knicks, but I think Spurs will win on Sunday to go to the finals.

text_blocks.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
text_blocks.text: I feel like Knicks will be the one to maintain. In basketball there is a momentum. If you win 11 in a row, then you can keep going. And you know the city just rallies behind them.

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo on the most intense arenas in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: The best arena was Boston, Philly. 76ers, they have passionate fans.

text_blocks.speaker: Marlon
text_blocks.text: Is that the craziest arena you play in?

text_blocks.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
text_blocks.text: No. Because when we were good, it was not that good. I feel like the best arena was Boston, Philly. 76ers, they have passionate fans. Boston, passionate, Philadelphia, 76ers, they have passionate fans.

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo on the atmosphere of EuroLeague versus NBA
quotes.excerpt: The atmosphere you feel in Greece, you won't feel it nowhere.

text_blocks.speaker: Marlon
text_blocks.text: I still don't even think a finals game would be better than the EuroLeague.

text_blocks.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
text_blocks.text: The atmosphere you feel in Greece, you won't feel it nowhere. Nowhere.
